description_en: Queries a list of hybrid cloud clusters
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-clusters --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uqm35000002 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudClusters

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
要操作的WAF实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html查询WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AccessMode.description_en:
The network access mode. Valid values:

internet: Internet access.

vpc: leased line-based private network access
AccessMode.description_zh:
网络接入模式。取值范围如下：

internet：公网接入。
vpc：专线私网接入

AccessRegion.description_en:
The region where the leased line is connected. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Hangzhou

cn-beijing: Beijing

cn-shanghai: Shanghai
AccessRegion.description_zh:
专线接入区域。取值范围如下：
cn-hangzhou : 杭州
cn-beiijng : 北京
cn-shanghai : 上海

ClusterResourceId.description_en: The resource ID of the hybrid cloud cluster

HttpPorts.description_en: The ports that use the HTTP protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are returned, they are separated by commas in the port1,port2,port3 format
HttpPorts.description_zh: HTTP协议的端口列表。 取值为字符串， 多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回

HttpsPorts.description_en: The ports that use the HTTPS protocol. The value is a string. If multiple ports are returned, they are separated by commas in the port1,port2,port3 format
HttpsPorts.description_zh: HTTPS协议的端口列表。 取值为字符串， 多个端口时，使用port1,port2,port3的格式返回

ProtectionServerCount.description_en: The number of protection nodes that you can add to the cluster
ProtectionServerCount.description_zh: 集群可添加的防护节点数量

ProxyStatus.description_en:
The status of the proxy. Valid values:

on: enabled

off: disabled
ProxyStatus.description_zh:
代理网关模式。取值范围如下：
on：开启
off：关闭

ProxyType.description_en:
The type of the cluster. Valid values:

cname: reverse proxy cluster

service: service cluster
ProxyType.description_zh:
集群类型。取值范围如下：
cname：反代集群
service：服务化集群

RuleStatus.description_en:
The status of the manual bypass setting. Valid values:

on: enabled.

off: disabled
RuleStatus.description_zh:
手动Bypass状态，取值范围如下：

on：开启。

off：关闭

RuleType.description_en:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

bypass: WAF does not perform security checks and allows traffic to pass through
RuleType.description_zh:
规则类型。取值范围如下：
bypass：不做安全检查，直接放行
